root_cause: Netlify sent BG_PORTAL_EU_SERVICE_TOKEN to content-operations, while content-operations authenticated only against POWERHOUSE_SHARED_SECRET/POWERHOUSE_TOKEN Edge Function environment variables that were absent. The canonical social publisher already authenticated against bg_geheim('powerhouse_daily_scheduler_token'), so the two adjacent functions had diverged authentication authorities.
prevention_rule: All internal content-publication functions must resolve the canonical scheduler token from one authority. Critical social recovery compute must run in the EU function region near the canonical EU Supabase project; environment auth remains bounded fallback only.

runtime: content-operations production v5 used only Edge Function env-secret authentication
Supabase project secret inventory did not contain POWERHOUSE_SHARED_SECRET or POWERHOUSE_TOKEN
content-operations v6 was deployed with canonical bg_geheim primary auth
Netlify social-publication-delivery and deploy recovery are pinned to region fra.
production_readback: Supabase edge logs around 2026-10-06 08:04Z also showed PostgREST HTTP 522 responses, so provider-side publication remains fail-closed until database access recovers.

contributing_cause: The critical Netlify social recovery functions were running in IAD/N. Virginia while the canonical Supabase project is eu-central-1. During the incident, the eastern-US path showed repeated PostgREST 522 responses.
